lines: Build planner: the off hand now takes one-handed weapons (wands and others) for dual wielding. A two-hander takes no off hand, and a quiver goes only with a bow; an off hand that no longer fits is taken off with a note.
Gear Set Sim: Max Riven mods now starts at 0 (no Riven mods). Raise it or clear the box to allow them. The Riven and Vows boxes are highlighted.
Gear Set Sim: new 'Never pick Core uniques' tick box.
Gear Set Sim: two one-handed weapons (wands, for one) can now be dual wielded, and are scored against a single staff. Never with a two-hander.
Gear Set Sim: new 'Sockets on rares' setting (default up to 3). Rares get no sockets below item level 30.
Gear Set Sim: a quiver or shield left beside a weapon it can't be held with is now cleared.
Item Search: fixed a blank page when the Tier filter was set to Riven or Mythic. If your Item Search is blank, this fixes it.
Gear Set Sim: new 'Optimize idols with 1-6 affixes per idol' selector. It picks idol sizes that fit the Fossil grid (21 cells) and the best lines for each.
Gear Set Sim: new 'Max Riven mods (total)' box that limits Riven mods across the whole build, with a short explainer.
Character tab: Save item keeps an item in this browser; put it on again from Change item, under Saved, on any character or plan.
Character tab: Copy gear / Paste gear and Copy skills / Paste skills move a whole set from one character or plan to another.
Item editor: a rare can take its Oathsworn line (the Cube's 7th line) and a Scarred line (from Unswearing) under Extra lines; Riven mods are marked in the lists.
Damage: a Scarred line gets no Great or Flawless Rare boost, and boosted lines round as the game does (45 becomes 58, not 59). Checked on an in-game tooltip.
Item editor: a value outside its tier's range is flagged, and the add-affix lists are readable in dark mode.
Start a New Plan: a Continue button opens the Character tab; on the Skills tab the plan setup folds into one line.
Save Creator: a skill bar mapper under QoL puts skills on the mouse buttons, keys 1-5 and the Ctrl bar. Not tried in the game yet: keep a copy of your old save.

Guardian resistance, checked in the game: the strong element (+20%) and weak element (-20%) add to the level resistance, the colour and Ward. The total stops at 75% (the sim had 85%), and the weak element can go below 0%.
The Hellguard Captain now has its strong (Fire) and weak (Lightning) element in Configure Enemy and the FAQ.

Configure Enemy: pick the Guardian, or set its strong element (+20% resistance) and weak element (-20% resistance). The sim counts them; how they stack with the colour and Ward is not checked in a fight yet.
The Configure Enemy button is easier to spot and is on the Character tab too.
Build tab: adding a skill no longer switches the Damage tab to it or breaks the Main selector.
Character tab: Add skill button (hover a skill for its tooltip) and a × to remove a skill, with a confirmation.
Skill tooltips now show the real numbers (blades, projectiles, chains) instead of {OrbitCount}-style placeholders.
Site ownership check for Google Search Console, so the site can be listed on Google.
Each page now has its own title and description, so the site can show up in search results and link previews.
Gear comparison: with Legion of One, only the strongest summon counts.
Damage: Legion of One is counted. One kind of minion stands, twice as many (at least +2), dealing 30% less.
Skill tree and Total DPS: with Legion of One, only the strongest of the summons you count is counted.
Hover text everywhere now shows in the page's own tooltip box.
Spelling: Defence, as the game writes it.
Gear Set Sim: the Max lines on rares box is gone; Max Vows on uniques stays.
Passive tree: the DPS / Defence slider is on the optimizer too. Optimize tree and Plan follow it.
Defence estimate: armour, evasion and block now count, with tick boxes for which defences your build uses (Item Simulator and Passive tree).
Gear Set Sim: two new boxes limit the lines on rares and the Vows on uniques. Empty means 6, as before.
Item Simulator: a DPS / Defence slider. Item Compare now recommends which item to wear from it, and the Gear Set Sim searches with it.
Gear Set Sim: new Reach max resistances option (target 75%, Poison optional).
Build Planner: the Gear tab is gone. Click a slot on the Character tab to pick or edit an item.

Support gems: Spell Totem, Orbit, Rain, Trap, Skyfall and Focused Volley are no longer offered for skills they cannot go into (Winter Orb, Orbiting Hammers, Crescent Slash, Sparks, Woes and others). Trap and Skyfall are offered for the Ballista.
Minions: the zone level bonus now follows the game's own rule, so it depends on the gem's level too. Grave Golem numbers change the most.
Sparks: with several Spark skills on your bar, each one strikes for less on an enemy that carries them all (80% with two, 73% with three, 70% with four).
Movement skills: the cooldown shortens with every gem level and recovers with Dexterity, not cast speed. Mana cost follows the gem's own level, and maximum mana is higher from level 36.
Rare items: crafted and Oathsworn lines are not counted for Great or Flawless and are not boosted. Boosted lines are rounded like in the game.
Traps, Ballistas and very fast skills: re-arm speed past +100% counts in full, Ballista repeats past the second deal 50%, and no skill is used faster than once per 0.12 s.
